partition_assertions.count_policy: A partition of retained nodes; not additional tests or acceptance counts.

shard_guidance: Minimum repair can use the five whole modules as separate indexed jobs. If profiling identifies an expensive genuine case, use the exact collected-node partition above: four genuine single-node shards plus five control shards. No deselection/skip/xfail; union receipt must verify original collected set, duplicate-free selections, and all actual passing logs.

possible_shared_serialization_hotspots.finding: validate_page_envelope() canonicalizes/hash-inspects each raw native row twice on a supported page (initial negative leads and later accepted envelope). _request() reparses exact response after response_lead parsing.
possible_shared_serialization_hotspots.classification: Static redundant-work observation; performance impact not timed here; not a confirmed application defect.

possible_shared_serialization_hotspots.finding: One report/load traverses separate required validators that reparse/revalidate pages; IndexedResolver caches its private per-load snapshot, but this cache does not unify sibling page validators. Inspect root profile before deciding whether per-operation immutable cache is necessary.
possible_shared_serialization_hotspots.classification: Potential shared hot path, not proven cancellation cause.

possible_shared_serialization_hotspots.finding: Every canonicalization walks the object iteratively to enforce depth/node/cycle/key constraints before json.dumps. Retaining these checks is required; do not bypass them or cache across mutable reports/source restoration.
possible_shared_serialization_hotspots.classification: Expected safety cost; optimization requires preserved immutable source identity and dependency-loss semantics.

timing_evidence_limit: No test bodies or profiler executed by this reviewer. Stored full backend receipt records 3007 passed + 440 separately reported subtests in 491.47s, without per-node durations. This does not attribute native indexed cancellation to any individual test.
